Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /assets/CREDENTIALS.md:
     1	# Environment Variables
     2	
     3	The shop ledger is Postgres. A local file is not the books.
     4	
     5	## Stripe test mode
     6	
     7	`STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` and `STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` are required for Checkout.
     8	
     9	**Temporary packaging note:** until the Harbor portal injects these as job
    10	secrets (the same way it supplies `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`), the task zip embeds
    11	Stripe **test-mode** keys in `task.toml` `[environment.env]` and
    12	`[verifier.env]` so oracle/model runs can launch. Prefer `${STRIPE_*}`
    13	platform injection once secrets are available; do not use live keys.
    14	
    15	- `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` — Stripe test secret key (server-side only)
    16	- `STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` — Stripe test publishable key (browser if needed)
    17	
    18	Obtain test keys from the [Stripe Dashboard](https://dashboard.stripe.com/test/apikeys).
    19	
    20	## Shop Postgres
    21	
    22	`DATABASE_URL` points at the shop cluster (default
    23	`postgres://gearvault:gearvault@127.0.0.1:5432/gearvault`). The image
    24	ships PostgreSQL. If the socket is down, start the local cluster the
    25	image already has (`/opt/gearvault-postgres/start.sh` or
    26	`pg_ctlcluster 16 main start`) before the app.
    27	
    28	- `DATABASE_URL` — server-side only
    29	
    30	## Shop-network vendor desks
    31	
    32	During grading the desks listen on `VENDOR_BASE_URL` (default
    33	`http://localhost:3101`). The container image starts Postgres and the vendor
    34	desks in the background at boot (`/opt/gearvault-shop/entrypoint.sh`). If the
    35	socket is down, start them explicitly:
    36	
    37	```bash
    38	/opt/gearvault-shop/wait-shop-network.sh
    39	```
    40	
    41	The till is not supposed to invent the numbers those desks already know.
    42	
    43	What lives out there, in the shop's own words:
    44	
    45	- the county tax office (Riverside, Downtown, and Pier are not the same window)
    46	- the hull insurance bureau, which also keeps signed binds after a drone
    47	  is actually paid
    48	- the weekend surcharge desk
    49	- the weather desk
    50	- the holiday / blackout desk (the week the shops go dark; van idle on dark days)
    51	- the notice desk (the paper copy of a paid ticket)
    52	- the SMS desk (the text that is supposed to go out the same moment)
    53	- the email desk (the email copy that is supposed to go out the same moment)
    54	- the shop diary
    55	- the photo desk (Riley's pictures)
    56	- the fleet serial desk (bay code for each serialized tag before a scan)
    57	- the bay serial-scan desk (nothing leaves without a live scan)
    58	- the loyalty desk (member cards only — Maya gets a punch when Stripe clears)
    59	- the transfer bureau (Noah is the only one they will stamp a move for)
    60	
    61	How the desks expect to be greeted:
    62	
    63	- `VENDOR_BASE_URL` — origin of the desks
    64	- `VENDOR_TOKEN` — `Authorization: Bearer …` for the desks that take a
    65	  shop-network token
    66	- `NOTICE_API_KEY` — `X-Notice-Key` for the copy desks (paper notices,
    67	  texts, photo tickets)
    68	- `INSURANCE_HMAC_SECRET` — the bureau uses this when it signs a hull
    69	  bind. A bind without that signature, or with a signature that is not
    70	  the bureau's, is not a bind.
    71	
    72	The desks answer for the seeded shops and categories. They have a health
    73	surface. Do not hard-code a single tax percentage, a hull line on every
    74	kit, a closed week, or a weekend number someone remembered. What a desk
    75	answers is the desk's business; deciding which figure to hand a desk,
    76	and what to do with the number that comes back, is the shop's.
    77	
    78	## Application
    79	
    80	- `PORT` — defaults to `3000`.
    81	- `BASE_URL` — defaults to `http://localhost:3000`.
    82	- `NODE_ENV` — runtime mode.
    83	
    84	`OPENROUTER_API_KEY` is verifier-only (judge) and is supplied by the platform
    85	via `${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}` — it is not placed in the agent environment.
